title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
Location: Noida

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 14, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1747234

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**

  

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.

**The Opportunity**

  

The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.

  

The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

  

**Skills And Attributes for Success**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

  

**What working at EY offers**

  

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior AI Technologist
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this opportunity:**

The AI Technologist – Autonomous Networks designs, builds and industrialises AI/ML, GenAI and agentic AI solutions for network managed services and network intelligence. The role applies advanced AI to large-scale telecom and IT data, develops production-grade models, pipelines and digital-engineer agents, and collaborates with AI Domain Solution Leaders, architects and product teams to deliver scalable, secure and trustworthy solutions for Ericsson and its customers.

**What you will do:**

* Identify and lead AI/ML, GenAI and agentic AI opportunities across Ericsson businesses and strategic customers.
* Define data science problem statements, model validation strategies and measurable business outcomes.
* Design data architectures, data flows, feature engineering approaches and ML, deep learning, GenAI and agentic AI architectures.
* Develop and deploy predictive, anomaly detection, recommendation, root-cause and other AI/ML solutions using large-scale 4G/5G/5G-Advanced, IoT and OSS/BSS data.
* Design and implement GenAI solutions using LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agent orchestration and autonomous or assisted digital-engineer workflows for network operations.
* Lead PoCs and MVPs from problem definition and data exploration through production deployment and monitoring.
* Industrialise AI solutions with product teams through production-grade code, APIs, workflows and documentation.
* Build scalable data pipelines and storage/retrieval solutions for structured and unstructured data, including KPIs, logs, text and images.
* Own the MLOps lifecycle covering training, deployment, serving, monitoring, evaluation and model lifecycle management.
* Integrate AI models with network automation applications and Ericsson platforms through standard APIs and automation interfaces.
* Apply trustworthy-AI principles, guardrails, explainability, security and human-in-the-loop controls for safe deployment in live networks.

**The skills you bring:**

* Bachelor's/Master's/Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of industry experience, including 5+ years of production-level AI/ML experience, with hands-on GenAI and/or agentic AI development.
* Proven experience taking AI/ML and GenAI solutions from problem definition to production, including LLM assistants, RAG and AI agents.
* Strong programming and software-engineering skills with modern AI/ML and deep-learning frameworks, APIs, version control, testing and CI/CD.
* Strong knowledge of MLOps, SDLC, observability, security, model evaluation, configuration management and production readiness.
* Practical experience with the GCP AI ecosystem, including Vertex AI, Gemini, ADK, Agent Engine/Runtime, Model Garden, vector search, BigQuery, Spanner, Knowledge Catalog and Agent Gateway.
* Strong understanding of agentic AI architecture, including orchestration, agent harnesses, A2A, MCP, memory management, context engineering and token/cost optimisation.
* Hands-on expertise in data engineering, pipelines, big-data processing, storage, indexing, partitioning and retrieval.
* Telecommunications or IoT experience, particularly 4G/5G, OSS/BSS, network automation or network intelligence, is highly desirable.
* Ability to translate complex business and network challenges into practical AI solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong customer and value orientation, collaboration, creativity, ownership and ability to drive complex initiatives to completion.
* Experience with AI/ML communities, technical publications, white papers, conferences or patents is a plus.

title: Data Science Mentor
description:
Tech Instructor & Learner Support : Data Science

**Department:** Learning & Support  
**Location:** Noida Sector 142 / On-site  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Working**: Monday - Saturday (6 Days)

About the Role

We are looking for a technically strong and learner-focused **Tech Instructor & Learner Support** professional to join Team CodeWithHarry.

The role involves a combination of **technical query resolution, learner support, and content-related assistance** across Python, C, Data Analytics, and Data Science programs. The ideal candidate should have strong programming fundamentals, excellent communication skills, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to learners at different levels.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Python & C Instruction:** Deliver clear and practical instruction on Python and C programming, helping learners understand concepts, solve problems, debug code, and strengthen their programming fundamentals.
* **Udemy Q&A Support:** Handle and resolve learner queries related to Python and C courses on Udemy with accurate, timely, and easy-to-understand responses.
* **Website Technical Support:** Address programming and technical queries received through the CodeWithHarry website and provide appropriate solutions or escalate complex issues to the relevant team.
* **DA/DS Learner Support:** Resolve learner queries related to Data Analytics and Data Science courses, including Python, SQL, data analysis, statistics, assignments, and related technical concepts.
* **Learner Guidance & Issue Resolution:** Identify learner difficulties, troubleshoot technical issues, and guide learners toward relevant course resources and solutions to ensure a smooth learning experience.
* **Feedback & Process Improvement:** Track recurring learner queries and common issues, share insights with internal teams, and contribute to improving course content, FAQs, and learner support processes.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of **Python and C programming**.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of **Data Analytics and Data Science concepts**.
* Familiarity with **SQL, Pandas, NumPy, data visualization, and basic statistics** is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple language.
* Comfortable working with learners and handling multiple queries.
* Good attention to detail and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, IT, Data Science, or a related field**.
* Prior experience as a **technical instructor, teaching assistant, developer, technical support executive, or learner support professional**.
* Experience working with online learning platforms such as **Udemy** is a plus.
* Teaching, mentoring, or community-support experience is an advantage.

What We’re Looking For

* **Strong technical fundamentals**
* **Clear and patient communication**
* **Problem-solving mindset**
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple technical queries efficiently.

**Key Performance Areas:**

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and quality of technical responses
* Response and resolution time
* Learner satisfaction and feedback
* Quality of Python & C instruction
* Effectiveness of issue resolution
* Ability to identify recurring learner problems
* Contribution to improving learner support processes and resources
* Ownership of assigned responsibilities

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

title: AI Architect
description:
**India T Special Bonus:**  
**Req ID:** 370506
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a AI Architect to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**JOB TITLE:** AI/ML Architect (Generative AI LLM Solutions)
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Architect with deep expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and scalable AI platform design. In this role, you will be responsible for defining architecture, guiding implementation, and ensuring the scalability, security, and reliability of enterprise-grade AI solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate business strategy into robust AI systems and frameworks.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
AI/ML Solution Architecture
  

* Define and design end-to-end AI/ML architectures, including data pipelines, model lifecycle, and deployment frameworks.
* Establish best practices, standards, and reusable frameworks for ML and Generative AI solutions.
* Provide architectural guidance on model selection, optimization strategies, and scalability considerations.
* Ensure systems are designed for high availability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Generative AI LLM Architecture
  

* Design and oversee development of LLM-based enterprise solutions (chatbots, summarization systems, semantic search, copilots).
* Define prompt engineering strategies, RAG architectures, and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Evaluate and select LLM providers, open-source models, and fine-tuning approaches.
* Architect secure and scalable integrations with APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, etc.).
* Lead design of vector database strategies and embedding pipelines.

Platform Engineering MLOps Strategy
  

* Architect enterprise MLOps frameworks, including CI/CD pipelines, model governance, and monitoring systems.
* Define model lifecycle management standards (MLflow, Langfuse, etc.).
* Oversee deployment strategies across cloud platforms (Azure preferred), including Databricks integration.
* Drive adoption of containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

Governance, Security Compliance
  

* Establish AI governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and enterprise security standards.
* Define policies for responsible AI, model explainability, and risk mitigation.
* Ensure data privacy, security, and auditability across all AI systems.

Leadership Collaboration
  

* Act as a technical leader and mentor for AI/ML engineers and data scientists.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to align AI initiatives with business goals.
* Drive architecture reviews, design decisions, and technical roadmaps.
* Communicate complex architectural concepts to both technical and executive stakeholders.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  
  
AI/ML Architecture Expertise
  

* Strong expertise in machine learning, deep learning, and NLP architectures.
* Proven experience designing large-scale AI/ML systems and platforms.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.).

Generative AI LLMs
  

* Deep experience with LLMs (GPT, BERT, open-source models) and Transformer architectures.
* Expertise in RAG, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and LLM evaluation frameworks.
* Experience designing enterprise-grade GenAI applications.

Cloud MLOps
  

* Strong experience with Azure AI/ML ecosystem, Databricks, and cloud-native architectures.
* Expertise in CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, and observability.
* Familiarity with containerization, Kubernetes, and distributed systems.

Architecture Design Skills
  

* Proven ability to design scalable, modular, and secure systems.
* Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, and event-driven architectures.

Leadership Strategy
  

* Experience leading technical teams and driving architecture decisions.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.

PREFERRED SKILLS
  

* Experience in healthcare or regulated industries (HIPAA, GDPR).
* Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Milvus).
* Exposure to Responsible AI frameworks and AI governance models.
* Certifications in Azure AI, AWS ML, or Enterprise Architecture frameworks.

EDUCATION CERTIFICATIONS
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field.
* Relevant certifications in Cloud, AI/ML, or Architecture are a plus.

ADDITIONAL ATTRIBUTES
  

* Strong communication skills with ability to influence cross-functional teams and leadership.
* Strategic thinker with a forward-looking approach to AI innovation.
* Ability to operate in global, distributed environments.

KEYWORDS FOR VISIBILITY
  
  
AI Architect, Generative AI Architect, LLM Architect, Enterprise AI, RAG, LangChain, Azure AI, MLOps Architecture, AI Governance, NLP Architect, Databricks, Vector DB, Responsible AI
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners.
